name: Kiol
source:
SSL's weary but cheery manager. Kiol has been head of the SSL office for centuries, so their experience and expertise are second to none, something which often causes conflict between them and Nyari who firmly believe she knows better.

Kiol is a hard worker in desesperate need of a holiday.
